description: Collect frame health, memory diagnostics, and platform profiling artifacts with compact agent-readable summaries. For CPU profiles, start and stop write the raw artifact while report writes a compact summary for readable native CPU evidence. Profiling output is evidence only: compact state, artifact path, and size. Times out after 90s.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

template.description: xctrace template name, for example Time Profiler.

tracePath.description: Existing .trace path to report, defaults to the latest session trace.

name: perf
title: Check frames, memory, or native profiles
